contracts: Newest 60 rows inside the six-hour/session/reset floor are selected and presented chronologically with deterministic timestamp/message-id/row ordering.
Omitted rows are consumed once, aggregate evidence is retained without bodies, and pending omission evidence is acknowledged with the successful cursor.
Failures before assistant delivery preserve selected context; terminal text, intentional silence, and duplicate-safe intermediate delivery followed by failure consume it.
/new and /reset persist an origin floor across restart without relying on sessions.created_at mutation.
Active maintenance expires stale unread rows and deletes only consumed bodies older than seven days while preserving recent retry-relevant rows.
Schema 12 upgrades monotonically to 13 while preserving lane jobs, monitor events/slots, and durable rebind counters.
Gateway status, ops cycle, CLI, and admin expose counts and timestamp ranges only, never context bodies.
